plain: Earn 5.00% interest a year for your first 6 months on up to $10,000, then a rate that can change, currently 3.75%.
alt: Get an introductory 5.00% APY for 6 months on up to $10,000 in savings, then a variable 3.75%.
frame_flip: Don't settle for a low rate: earn a 5.00% APY intro rate for 6 months on balances up to $10,000, then 3.75% variable.
reordered: On balances up to $10,000, earn 3.75% variable after a 6-month intro rate of 5.00% APY.
